messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a ~120ms p95 jump for /api/generate in prod-eu after we flipped the quota-routing change at 11:02. p50 barely moved.
ben: yikes. timeline? did the routing change also change model variant weights?
jordan: I deployed the quota routing (route -> burst-capacity pool) at 11:02 exactly. weights stayed same A:60 B:40.
maya: query I ran (from telemetry) — looks odd:
```
SELECT percentile_approx(latency_ms, 50) AS p50,
       percentile_approx(latency_ms, 95) AS p95,
       percentile_approx(latency_ms, 99) AS p99
FROM requests
WHERE route = '/api/generate' AND region = 'eu' AND ts >= '2026-03-18T10:30:00Z'
GROUP BY deployment_cohort;
```
maya: p95 for cohort=dedicated is +120ms vs before flip, cohort=shared unchanged. p99 noisy.
ben: are we sure percentile_approx is using same sample source? after routing we may be mixing telemetry from gateway vs compute, and gateway latencies get counted for some request classes.
jordan: good point — we route to burst pool that goes through the burst-gateway which adds ~80ms at peak. telemetry tagging should preserve origin but maybe rollup lost the origin tag.
eli: I ran a raw histogram pull and saw that the count for that cohort doubled but the sample origin label was missing on ~40% of rows. looks like the telemetry enrichment step (route->cohort tagger) is downstream of the router.
maya: so problem = origin tag loss -> rollup merges differently -> percentiles shift for per-cohort view. but that should affect p50 too? why p50 stable?
ben: because merge mode: our rollups use TDigest to merge per-shard tdigests. If missing origin, those requests get merged into the bigger shard which already had stable p50. p95 sensitive to tail additions.
console-bot: FYI: filed ENGPLAT-1219 "cohort tag loss after quota-routing -> percentile skew" and attached query samples.
jordan: quick mitigation: change console to show sample-count-by-origin next to percentile and a warning icon when origin counts drop >10%. also expose "rollup-merge-mode" tooltip (current: tdigest-unweighted).
eli: short-term hotfix: add an annotation on the dashboard overlay when routing policy changes correlate with percentile shifts. we can surface last-policy-change ts and link to PR.
b en: +1 for both. For longer term we should: 1) make enrichment synchronous (tag at ingress), 2) add provenance column to rollup metadata, 3) add pctl computation fallback that rejects merges when sample-origin entropy > threshold.
maya: UX ask: can console surface a diff view: same endpoint, split by route-provenance (gateway|burst|direct) and show per-provenance p50/p95/p99 with sample counts? that would make incidents much faster to triage.
console-bot: added as UI ticket ENG-UI-783.
ops-bot: deploy notice — rolled back quota-routing to previous config at 11:21.
maya: after rollback p95 returned to normal baseline within 3m. can we keep the cohort-split panel in the console for 2 weeks as an opt-in? engineers liked it.
jordan: will follow up on the telemetry side — I think the immediate cause is enrichment ordering; will push a small change to tag earlier.
ben: leave this thread for postmortem notes. TL;DR: routing change -> enricher ordering bug -> origin tag loss -> TDigest merge diluted p50 but amplified p95 tail. action items in ENGPLAT-1219 + ENG-UI-783.
